Applications now open! Welcome to Snackvivor, your friendly neighborhood yummalicious ORG! In Snackvivor, we focus on providing a high-quality ORG experience for all types of players, boasting an active, welcoming, and diverse community. Snackvivor: Pastadise Island is now casting 18 new players to cook up the best ORG you have ever seen! What we offer: ️ - An up and coming ORG community you can help build from the ground up (as a player or spectator!) - Interesting, entertaining, and thematically relevant twists to spice things up! - Fun challenges, spectator games, edgic, and more to keep everyone involved! - In server 1-on-1's and alliances for a great player and spectator experience - A wide array of incredible pasta emotes for added entertainment ️ - $50 Prize for the winner and many additional prizes for other players + spectators alike! So join Snackvivor today and cement your legacy in our fast-growing community! Applications close 2/22/2024 12:59 AM and castaways will be marooned into Snackvivor: Pastadise Island on 2/23/2024 7:00 PM!
Hanburger 2/2/2024 2:56 AM
cheese 2/3/2024 7:30 PM

Happy 1 Year of Snackvivor!

We truly cannot thank everyone here enough for all the amazing times we have had as a community. It is hard to believe how fast the time has gone by, but exactly one year ago to the minute, we set off for Cheeseland! Since then it has been nothing but incredible people coming together to laugh, love, cry, and all the other things we have done in Snackvivor. It has been so wonderful to see everyone rally behind the community and support each other, I can't wait for year two of Snackvivor because it is going to be even more of all the great things we have already done together. And on a personal note, I'm so grateful for all the people here in this community. When I stumbled into ORGs about a year and a half ago, I never thought they would have had as big of an impact on my life as they do. After playing my first ORG and experiencing the magic, I wanted to recreate that for so many more people. I'm so lucky for this hosting team, current and past, they are the best friends in the world and have brought me so much happiness and joy over the past year. I have so many great memories and I'm so thankful I get to call them my family. And to all our players and spectators, thank you for joining us on this journey and allowing us to be a great community. You are all the reason this place is so special and every day you continue to show how great the Snackvivor community is. So here is to many more years of Snackvivor! We have so much to celebrate (and a few surprises to do just that), so once again happy one year to Snackvivor!

If you didn't know, Snackvivor is a partner in an org hub called Org Constellation (linked below) Every month, OrgC holds a vote for "Star Org of the Month", where people can vote for an org that finished a season during that month. Fish The Second 11/3/2025 1:41 PM
Not gonna ping but I figured I'd send stuff here since there's been interest and I know a lot of you are Pokemon / Minecraft fans: For those of you who may not have seen, I was able to get my old Pixelmon server back up and running after a lengthy battle with Optimum to stop fucking my internet up LMAO. The server is basically a fully setup region with 8 Gyms and an Elite 4. The region that you spawn has pathways to each of the 8 towns and trainers along the routes to battle. A lot of the routes have extra things along the way like parkour tower, bike shop, side quests and more. My friends and I made this a couple years ago (and Pixelmon has since made some breaking changes so alas it is pretty much set to be version 8.0.2 but that still goes all the way up to Gen 8!) and put a shit ton of work into it (including @Bui) and I think you all would have a blast playing if that's your thing. The gyms are intentionally made to be pretty hard, elite 4 and champion as well. Obviously it's SV style where you can kinda go wherever since Minecraft so if you go to the starter gym with level 40s you'd crush it lol. Perchance you can become the first person to beat the Elite 4 in 5 years LMAO (Gnocchi is hauling ass to be the first, don't give him that...) Each town also has multiple secrets including hidden signs that give special items, and a hidden questline to find more secret goodies. There is also hidden things in towns that will get you access to the nether, end and ultra dimension. The towns are also sorta themed around the gym type of said town, and there are spawners for mons of said type in the towns. There is also a safari zone that has each biome available in the game (IIRC) so if you are looking for a specific mon you can look there. There are tons of little secrets and easter eggs around the map that you can find, and this server used to run for a few years so you can definitely find some old builds of past players. There's also the Hall of Champions where all the old champions are stored for rebattling. Oh, and there's also a post game battle tower where you can earn BP that you can exchange for prizes. Lastly, if you want to just do normal Minecraft things, you can do /rtp to go to the wilderness where free build is legal of course :) If you want to join in on the fun, simply ping me and I will give you the Pixelmon role which will give you access to the channel to see details about getting access to the server and also where people are chatting about it :) Also a word from our sponsor @prosciutto - "This shit is gas"

Fish The Second 2/1/2026 5:47 PM
@everyone
  • Hello everyone! Sorry for the ping but I wanted to both remind everyone that sign-ups are of course open and if you haven't applied yet you should!
I also wanted to provide some early patch notes for people (not 100% locked in but to give people an idea of what we have been working on) so they can better understand some changes from HG1 to HG2! Patch Notes for Hungry Games 2
  • Codebase -> heavily rewritten to be a lot less fucking stupid (it was really stupid)
  • New Map -> Slightly bigger and totally new Layout
  • HP -> Buffed from 10 total to 15 total
  • AC -> Nerfed from 13 base to 11 base
  • Events -> More punishing than before, while we still don't want to outright kill you via the events, we want them to have more stakes and if some of you must die for that to happen well...
  • Searching -> Split from stamina, you now have a base of 7 searches at a time that, like stamina, refreshes based on sleep (roughly 1 per 25 minutes)
  • Searching -> Now nerfed if multiple people are in the same area as you! If 2 people are in the same area, -2 to your rolls, if 3 people are in the same area -4, if 4+ people in the same area, auto fail (This limitation does NOT apply to the cornucopia)
  • Kill Changes -> Every kill will grant you either +1 food or +1 water (as the sponsors reward good behavior!)
  • Kill Changes -> Every 2 kills will grant you a permanent stat buff of your choice (lowered from 3)
  • Items -> We have totally changed the loot tables and made it so that better weapons are more easily found at the cornucopia, and item spread is very specific, certain areas will only reward certain things
  • Items -> Pocket Sands availability has been heavily nerfed, it still exists but its really rare
  • Items -> A bunch of new items, some that have passive effects!
  • Items -> Backpacks of various sizes that help your carryCapacity
  • CarryCapacity -> Nerfed from 20 base to 18 base
  • Items -> Fishing Rods that allow you to fish in certain zones
  • Items -> Some items weight / price / etc have been adjusted
  • Items -> Items that represent s8, s9, s10 and M1 have been added
  • Fishing -> We added fishing! Fishing only works in certain zones but it gives unique loot!
  • Cornucopia -> The first cornucopia search can never fail, honestly, not sure why I made it fail to begin with, and is mostly guaranteed to find a weapon, or a rare item
  • Dexterity Nerf -> Mostly this is nerfed due to Searching being split and AC being nerfed
  • Intelligence Buff -> The amounts for how much event buffs or nerfs you got have changed a bit (-15 to -20, -8 to -10, 8 to 10, 15 to 20 in terms of percentages)
  • Intelligence Buff -> Lose less hunger / thirst per day as you are able to more smartly ration your food
  • Criticals from Nat 20s -> Unsurprisingly, you don't actually roll that many d20s, but when you land a nat 20 in combat you get max damage +2 guaranteed
  • Inventory -> Upon death, there is a random chance for each of your items (50%) to drop to the floor for opponents to pickup, the rest are considered too damaged to pick up
  • Sleep -> Now when you are asleep, you have your sendMessages turned off, so you cant speak to others, but you do get adrenaline for a good sleep and a full nights rest gives you +2 healing
  • Combat -> No eating / drinking / healing during combat
  • Combat -> Rewritten a bit so hopefully less buggy :)
  • Stamina -> Certain rolls are nerfed if you have 0 stamina (this was in HG1 but I forgot to tell yall)
  • Stamina -> Nerfed from base 30 to 25
  • Hunger & Thirst -> If you hit 0 in either of these, your HP instantly drops to 1 as you are basically dying from starvation / dehydration
  • Pets -> I will go into no further details, but they exist
That's most of it? I'm sure I missed stuff we changed a lot (edited)

Fish The Second
@everyone
  • Hello everyone! Sorry for the ping but I wanted to both remind everyone that sign-ups are of course open and if you haven't applied yet you should!
I also wanted to provide some early patch notes for people (not 100% locked in but to give people an idea of what we have been working on) so they can better understand some changes from HG1 to HG2! Patch Notes for Hungry Games 2
  • Codebase -> heavily rewritten to be a lot less fucking stupid (it was really stupid)
  • New Map -> Slightly bigger and totally new Layout
  • HP -> Buffed from 10 total to 15 total
  • AC -> Nerfed from 13 base to 11 base
  • Events -> More punishing than before, while we still don't want to outright kill you via the events, we want them to have more stakes and if some of you must die for that to happen well...
  • Searching -> Split from stamina, you now have a base of 7 searches at a time that, like stamina, refreshes based on sleep (roughly 1 per 25 minutes)
  • Searching -> Now nerfed if multiple people are in the same area as you! If 2 people are in the same area, -2 to your rolls, if 3 people are in the same area -4, if 4+ people in the same area, auto fail (This limitation does NOT apply to the cornucopia)
  • Kill Changes -> Every kill will grant you either +1 food or +1 water (as the sponsors reward good behavior!)
  • Kill Changes -> Every 2 kills will grant you a permanent stat buff of your choice (lowered from 3)
  • Items -> We have totally changed the loot tables and made it so that better weapons are more easily found at the cornucopia, and item spread is very specific, certain areas will only reward certain things
  • Items -> Pocket Sands availability has been heavily nerfed, it still exists but its really rare
  • Items -> A bunch of new items, some that have passive effects!
  • Items -> Backpacks of various sizes that help your carryCapacity
  • CarryCapacity -> Nerfed from 20 base to 18 base
  • Items -> Fishing Rods that allow you to fish in certain zones
  • Items -> Some items weight / price / etc have been adjusted
  • Items -> Items that represent s8, s9, s10 and M1 have been added
  • Fishing -> We added fishing! Fishing only works in certain zones but it gives unique loot!
  • Cornucopia -> The first cornucopia search can never fail, honestly, not sure why I made it fail to begin with, and is mostly guaranteed to find a weapon, or a rare item
  • Dexterity Nerf -> Mostly this is nerfed due to Searching being split and AC being nerfed
  • Intelligence Buff -> The amounts for how much event buffs or nerfs you got have changed a bit (-15 to -20, -8 to -10, 8 to 10, 15 to 20 in terms of percentages)
  • Intelligence Buff -> Lose less hunger / thirst per day as you are able to more smartly ration your food
  • Criticals from Nat 20s -> Unsurprisingly, you don't actually roll that many d20s, but when you land a nat 20 in combat you get max damage +2 guaranteed
  • Inventory -> Upon death, there is a random chance for each of your items (50%) to drop to the floor for opponents to pickup, the rest are considered too damaged to pick up
  • Sleep -> Now when you are asleep, you have your sendMessages turned off, so you cant speak to others, but you do get adrenaline for a good sleep and a full nights rest gives you +2 healing
  • Combat -> No eating / drinking / healing during combat
  • Combat -> Rewritten a bit so hopefully less buggy :)
  • Stamina -> Certain rolls are nerfed if you have 0 stamina (this was in HG1 but I forgot to tell yall)
  • Stamina -> Nerfed from base 30 to 25
  • Hunger & Thirst -> If you hit 0 in either of these, your HP instantly drops to 1 as you are basically dying from starvation / dehydration
  • Pets -> I will go into no further details, but they exist
That's most of it? I'm sure I missed stuff we changed a lot (edited)

Fish The Second 3/1/2026 10:06 PM
@deleted-role - Hey everyone, I wanted to make some announcements now that the game is over! First, I want to say congrats to @Phoebe! You played such a good game and were such a strong and deserving winner :) Second, I want to say thank you to everyone from the host team to the players to the spectators who made this all come together. Obviously there is no games without the people who play, there's no fun sponsors without the people who watch, and there's no games without the host team helping make it a reality. Third, I hope you all had fun, or at least had fun at some point LOL. I know that dying early, or getting jumped by a group of people, or missing a billion detects in a row (I PROMISE IT'S 40% TO PASS I DON'T KNOW WHY THE BOT HATES YOU ALL) can be really sucky and unfun. I'm sure you all had highs and lows in the game, which feels appropriate to kinda what the Hunger Games is in a way I suppose, but in the end I guess what I mostly hope is that you don't really regret having played, and if you did I am truly sorry :( Fourth, sorry that the reunion stuff is tomorrow, we kinda don't know for sure when the game will end despite pushing for an ending at points, so for this kinda game we just gotta do it a little later sorry :( Fifth, in regards to like big groups and stuff, despite the obvious spectator dislike of them, this is a social game at it's core. Teaming up is like, just a reality of how the meta of the game works, and how it will always work no matter how many changes we make. We can incentivize killing and stuff, but groups will always be a thing. Obviously when they get so big that it stagnates the game we try and shake it up (literally), but I don't want people to walk away thinking that they are bad people or stupid for doing groups. Sure, it can be boring, and most of you say that yourself LOL. It's not really a problem that is really solvable because at it's core groups are SUPER important and relevant. The bees is a thing we made on the fly this game, and I think they worked well and can work in the future as a deterrant, but like, please don't get hung up on the group stuff and if people liked it or didn't like it. It's a valid way to play, even if people think it's boring at times. Sixth, probably with the reunion stuff tomorrow will also be a feedback form for potential changes for a future game if we ever do another one. So... I'll be real with y'all for a moment. This is so very clearly a passion project for me and the other hosts, but the bot stuff really is just me and it's very much what makes the game run at all. I want to up front apologize for any like bugs in the code and stuff that y'all had to encounter in the game, we really do try and playtest what we can and make sure it runs great for you all from the get go (and compared to HG1 I'd say this was a major success LMAO), but plenty of small things slip through the cracks. I never, ever, ever, ever want to look at the code for !whose-turn again. Anyways, what I want to say is with the feedback, of course we want and welcome it but uhh... please be constructive and kind. I say this because, again to be real with y'all for a moment, I put a lot of work into this to make it run, and clearly it means a lot to me or I wouldn't be ignoring my day job, answering pings at all hours of the day and making new features and bug fixes every single day if it didn't. It's because I put so much into this game that reading negative feedback is like... pretty tricky for me I can't lie. I may or may not have cried a little bit during the game at one point over some stuff people said and normally that stuff doesn't really get to me, but in this game it did. At the end of the day I just want the game to be fun for everyone, so reading that people had a bad time playing something I worked tirelessly on does sting a bit. Regardless, I do want and appreciate any and all feedback, but again, please be kind.
